summary: GSK plc filed a Form 6-K with its Q2 2026 unaudited financial results on July 28, 2026. It reports total sales of £8.4 billion (+5% CER), total operating profit of £481 million (-75% AER, -75% CER), and core EPS of 50.5p (+9%). The filing details pipeline updates — including two NSCLC medicines acquired (Jideytro, neladalkib), positive phase III data for Ris-Rez in lung cancer, and a decision not to progress camlipixant following CALM-1/2 phase III results. It announces a 3-year programme targeting £1.9 billion in annual savings by 2029, reaffirms 2026 guidance (turnover +3% to +5%, core OP +7% to +9%, core EPS +7% to +9%), declares a Q2 dividend of 17p, and confirms completion of a £2 billion buyback. This is a routine quarterly earnings report, not an event-driven special situation.
